verdict.rationale: Privacy controls such as opting out of telemetry or usage tracking are a fair question for a SaaS email platform and its SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents such an opt-out. The open and click tracking it describes measures email recipients' behavior, a different feature, and does not count as opting the user out of product telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
